name: infantry-fengtian
_doc: Fengtian (봉천) rifleman: infantry-default body/poses/rifle/pack, but a plain low round cloth cap (team-colour band), light blue-grey tunic AND trousers (fengtian_bg), puttees. No bayonet: charge/melee use a dadao (officer sword poses, rifle slung on the back); dadao sheathed at the left hip otherwise.
